title: Guardian Anti-Cheat
description: Guardian Anti-Cheat is a good Anti-Cheat with GUI, tracker, logs...
body:
🛡 GuardianAC

A modern, optimized, and reliable anti-cheat solution designed for competitive Minecraft servers.

⚡ About GuardianAC

GuardianAC is an advanced anti-cheat plugin developed by VTH Group for Paper servers running on 1.21.1+. It is built to detect unfair gameplay with high accuracy while maintaining excellent server performance.

From combat cheats to movement exploits, GuardianAC provides powerful real-time detections, detailed player logs, and a complete administration system to help staff manage violations efficiently.

✨ Features

  • ⚔ Advanced combat detections
  • 🏃 Movement and speed exploit prevention
  • 🧱 Scaffold & FastPlace checks
  • 📦 Inventory and packet analysis
  • 📊 Detailed violation logs
  • 🖥 Fully functional Admin GUI
  • ⚡ Optimized for performance
  • 🔧 Highly configurable checks
  • 📁 SQLite database support
  • 🚫 Automatic punishments & autoban system

🧠 Included Detections

  • KillAura
  • AutoClicker
  • Reach
  • Speed
  • Fly
  • NoFall
  • Scaffold
  • FastPlace
  • Timer
  • InventoryHack
  • BadPackets
  • AntiAFK

📋 Administration Tools

GuardianAC includes a complete moderation system with:

  • 📑 Real-time alerts
  • 📂 Player violation history
  • 🔍 Staff inspection GUI
  • ⚙ Check management panel
  • 📈 TPS monitoring inside alerts
  • 📝 File logging system

⚙ Default Configuration

GuardianAC comes with a carefully balanced default configuration designed to reduce false positives while still detecting suspicious behavior effectively. 

✔ Optimized combat limits
✔ Lag compensation
✔ Adjustable punishments
✔ Performance-friendly checks
✔ Easy setup

🚀 Performance Focused

GuardianAC is designed to be lightweight and efficient. Every check is optimized to minimize server impact while maintaining reliable detections, making it suitable for both small communities and large competitive networks.

📌 Compatibility

  • ✅ Paper 1.21.1+
  • ✅ Java Edition
  • ✅ SQLite Support

💬 Why Choose GuardianAC?

GuardianAC combines performance, accuracy, and usability into a single anti-cheat solution. Whether you manage a practice server, minigame network, or survival community, GuardianAC helps keep gameplay fair without sacrificing server stability.

GuardianAC — Protect your server with intelligent detections.
